# Copilot Instructions

Read `CODING_AGENT_POLICY.md` at the repository root in full and apply it to every suggestion, review comment, and agent task in this repository.

`AGENTS.md` at the repository root states the precedence order among the policy, any organizational overlay, project requirements, and tool-specific files. Apply it as well.

This file adds no requirements of its own. Do not restate or paraphrase policy content here; change the policy and its changelog instead.
